text:
Priya: quick sync — we need to lock the post-launch iteration plan for the next 2 sprints. main tension: ship customer fixes vs. polish enhancements. low friction meeting at 11?
Ben: +1. can we put a clear rubric on what counts as 'critical' vs 'nice-to-have'? customers keep asking for both.
Carlos: suggested rubric in doc: severity x user-impact. if severity >=P1 or affects 2+ enterprise customers -> bug-first. else route to enhancements backlog. link: https://docs.redwood.com/postlaunch/triage-rubric
Tara: can we add a performance/regression bucket? a perf regression that increases p99 by >20% should escalate even if only 1 customer saw it.
Priya: yes — perf is its own axis. also want to reserve 1 developer per sprint for high-signal customer asks (fast lane).
Aisha: for the fast lane, what's SLA for response and ETA? customers expect 48h acknowledgement and a plan w/in 5 working days.
Priya: propose 48h ack, 5d plan, 2 sprint delivery target if feasible. exceptions for infra/security -> longer.
Ben: timeline sounds good. also: gating criteria for follow-on milestones — we should require no regressions on our core latency SLO and <2 outstanding P1s before we expand scope.
Carlos: +1. add opt-in telemetry checks in rollout: smoke evals for 5% traffic, then 20%, then full. ops-bot will post deploy results.
ops-bot: deploy check created for release/iteration-1 — smoke eval job queued. :robot_face:
Tara: backlog grooming ask: let's tag items with "customer-impact" and "dev-effort" and run 30m pre-groom to prioritize top 12 items for the sprint. saves time.
Aisha: can we include a small customer panel (3 pilot customers) to validate the fixes before wide rollout? they volunteered during launch.
Priya: yes — pilot customers = Acme, Nuvem, BrightData. add a canary flag and quick feedback loop.
Ben: one more: quant/quality tradeoff. if we apply a temporary quantized model to reduce cost, run a hallucination check against the eval set before enabling for real traffic.
Carlos: i'll add a checklist item:
```
- smoke eval (latency, p99)
- quality check (eval suite, hallucination rate)
- customer canary verify
- rollback window & metrics watch
```
Tara: who owns the rollback? ops oncall + release eng. add an explicit owner in the runbook.
Priya: ok — owners: Carlos (quality lead), Ben (product / customer comms), Tara (release), ops-bot (monitoring).
Aisha: i'm going to open the sprint card and pre-tag items. will ping owners for estimates.
Priya: great. final ask: by EOD pls add estimated dev days and acceptance criteria to each card. we'll confirm at 11. :thumbsup:
Ben: acked. see you all at 11.
ops-bot: reminder set for 11:00 — Post-launch iteration huddle
